---\nname: Feature Request\ndescription: A template for feature request issues.\n---\n\n## Feature Description\n\n<!-- A clear and concise description of the feature you want to request. -->\n\n## Use Case\n\n<!-- Describe the use case for this feature, explaining how it would be beneficial. -->\n\n## Expected Behavior\n\n<!-- Describe what you expect the behavior of this feature to be. -->\n\n## Why It's Important\n\n<!-- Explain why this feature is important and what impact it would have. -->
